subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the remaining Microsoft Teams attachment fix use the broader no-new-config channel Graph fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738, the narrower default-off group-chat option in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096, or a combined approach?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the two open PRs represent different operator tradeoffs around extra Graph lookups, config surface, and channel versus group-chat coverage.

options.title: Land the broader channel repair
options.body: Review and land the no-new-config Teams plugin fix after accepting its Graph fallback tradeoff, then close this issue from the merged PR.

options.title: Narrow to group-chat opt-in
options.body: Keep the config-gated PR scoped to group chats and leave the channel URL/root-message bugs to the broader candidate.

options.title: Combine the approaches
options.body: Require one PR to include both the full channel URL repair and any explicit opt-in policy before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land the broader channel repair
recommendation.body: Review and land the no-new-config Teams plugin fix after accepting its Graph fallback tradeoff, then close this issue from the merged PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is about plugin-boundary and config/fallback product direction, and steipete is the strongest available routing signal for that boundary.
